title: Android / Vulkan crash on `RenderingDeviceDriverVulkan::command_pipeline_barrier` on Mali GPU (analytics report)
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.6.stable
- Didn't check if reproduced on earlier releases

### System information

Pixel 8 Pro, Android 16 Beta, Mali G715

### Issue description

This is a copy of a Google Play crash report for the Godot Editor on Android after it was updated to 4.6.stable yesterday.

We don't have more info than just the stacktrace, so we have to work from that.

So far it's just reproduced on one device (Pixel 8 Pro) but we just released 4.6.stable so more reports might arrive in coming days.

Report for maintainers with access: https://play.google.com/console/u/0/developers/5310120689138741555/app/4972363226496209566/vitals/crashes/0c0b9fe83fd4b3b406800b2fc2648c1f/details?days=28&isUserPerceived=true&versionCode=40600500#

